issues.title: Custom domain not connecting
issues.problem_statement: The customer's domain was not connecting and the funnel opened only on the FlexiFunnels link.

items.description: Customer deleted the old A record in the GoDaddy DNS settings and saved, following support's guidance.
evidence: Delete kar diya, save bhi kar diya.

items.description: Customer added a CNAME record with the name www and the value shown in the FlexiFunnels domain settings, and saved it, following support's guidance.
evidence: CNAME add ho gaya aur save ho gaya sir.

items.description: After the DNS changes, the domain settings in FlexiFunnels showed the status as connected and the funnel opened on the domain.
evidence: Haan sir, connected dikh raha hai. Funnel domain par khul gaya.

items.description: Support explained that the SSL certificate padlock can take some time to appear.
evidence: SSL certificate ka padlock aane mein thoda time lagta hai.

items.description: Customer will check whether the SSL padlock has appeared and let support know if it has not.
evidence: Aap kal subah check kijiye, agar padlock na aaye to hamein bata dijiye.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with clear outcomes.
